main_measure.name: mean excess 3-bar forward return (vs coin's mean 3-bar return) on forecast>0 grid bars

statistic.name: t pooling the cases of one day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-pooled t >= 2 and slope > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: least-squares slope of excess 3-bar return on forecast

decided_by: the t is between -2 and 2 (or undefined), meeting neither confirm nor reject (inconclusive rule).
reading: cases are grid bars (positions 0,3,6,... of each window) with forecast > 0 and a full 3-bar forward return inside the window; the coin's mean 3-bar return is over the same grids of all its windows; the t is the mean over a day-clustered standard error (deviations summed per UTC day, D/(D-1) correction); the plan's 30 case-days minimum, when unmet, is reported as not observable.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.357 (not below 1), 115 cases (30 needed)
